decisions.reason: The About-page state was already revised at message 195 to remove Big Block content and retain only Small Block prize material; message 198 adds no further necessary change.
Removing Big Block frontend content does not change the independent requirement to display the book cover on the landing page.
The FAQ state was already revised at message 195 to remove Big Block prizes and tickets and reflect the new allocation; message 198 requires no additional FAQ update.
The removal of Big Block frontend material does not alter the current or planned product names.
The source Event changes landing-page content visibility, not the authentication policy or public availability of leaderboard and pool-value APIs.
Removing related frontend prize content does not change the email authentication method or dashboard-access behavior.
The source Event does not change the email provider, delivery behavior, notification channel, or defined email contents.
The landing-page content change does not alter Transak minting, supported fiat methods, wallet provisioning, or the requirement's deferred lifecycle.
The source Event does not change SIWE, supported users, or protected wallet-authentication flows.
The obsolete Big Block metadata counter was already removed by the message-195 MODIFY; message 198 only reiterates removal of corresponding frontend content.
The Big Block ticket lifecycle and scope context were already removed at message 195, so the frontend-content change at message 198 adds no lifecycle modification.
The generic rule that active prize tickets follow the NFT remains valid for the continuing Small Block tickets and does not require alteration when Big Block frontend content is removed.
